summary: Duplicate vendor invoice flagged due to cross-currency PO split
description: Issue summary: Finance identified two ledger entries for vendor 'GreenWave Logistics' invoice INV-2026-1176. One entry cleared in EUR for EUR 4,125.00 on 2026-03-08; a second USD entry was created during ingest and split across two POs (PO-2231 and PO-2232) with mismatched exchange conversions. Impact: Risk of duplicate payment and GL misallocation. Estimated potential overpayment ~USD 4,125 (before FX variance). Environment: Production AP ledger (NetSuite), vendor ingest pipeline 'vendor-ingest', payment run scheduled 2026-03-13 EOD. Steps to reproduce: 1) Search NetSuite for vendor + invoice number INV-2026-1176; 2) Compare invoice PDF to AP ledger entries and PO allocations; 3) Inspect ingest CSV and confirm how currency columns were mapped; 4) Check conversion rate used by NetSuite vs bank rate. Logs/attachments available: INV-2026-1176.pdf, ap-export-20260310.csv, screenshot-po-alloc.png.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 09:45 - Finance: Flagged duplicate lines with same invoice number but different currency columns. One mapped to PO-2231, the other to PO-2232.

2026-03-10 11:15 - AP Engineer (Connor Blake): Ingest job 'vendor-ingest' created separate ledger items for EUR and USD columns when both were present. Current logic creates distinct entries per currency column without deduping on (vendor, invoice_number).
2026-03-10 13:25 - Treasury (Lina Park): Bank EUR->USD conversion rate on 2026-03-08 differs from NetSuite conversion by 0.0023, producing a ~USD 36 variance on the allocations.
2026-03-11 08:50 - Finance Ops: Recommended immediate hold on the USD line to prevent duplicate payout. Consider consolidate into single settlement once vendor confirms intent.
2026-03-11 10:00 - Connor: Proposed short-term ingest rule to dedupe by (vendor, invoice_number) across currency columns for the same batch; needs engineering PR for permanent fix.
2026-03-12 09:10 - AP Manager (Marco Diaz): Reached out to vendor for confirmation; vendor requested 48h to check internal billing.
comments: Aisha Raman (Finance) 2026-03-10: Manually placed hold on USD payment line in NetSuite payment run. Please escalate to treasury for approval to hold and advise on reversal window.
Connor Blake (AP) 2026-03-10: Acknowledged. Will triage the ingest logic and produce a report of other batches in the same window.
Lina Park (Treasury) 2026-03-10: Approved hold. Confirm bank cut-off and reversal fees; low tolerance for duplicate payouts.
Marco Diaz (AP Manager) 2026-03-12: Vendor confirmed they received invoice but need to verify system that created duplicate lines. ETA 2026-03-14.
Connor Blake 2026-03-12: Deployed temporary non-persistent ingest rule to dedupe this CSV batch; this will not affect historical data. Engineering PR created for permanent fix.
resolution: Applied workaround: Held USD payment line in NetSuite and enabled temporary dedupe rule for current ingest batch to prevent repeat duplicates. Next steps: 1) Await vendor confirmation (ETA 2026-03-14). 2) If vendor confirms single settlement, AP to release single payment and reverse the held USD payout if necessary; finance to post GL reclassification to correct PO allocations. 3) Engineering to merge permanent change to 'vendor-ingest' to dedupe (see PR) and add unit tests for multi-currency CSVs. Owners: Connor (AP) to coordinate with vendor and finance; Engineering (owner TBD) to land PR and schedule deployment. Follow-up ticket required for engineering deployment and postmortem.
follow_up_actions: Create ENG ticket to change vendor-ingest dedupe logic and add tests - target 2026-03-19
Finance to reconcile GL and post adjustment entries after vendor confirmation
Re-run AP export and confirm single payment before next scheduled run
